page.notes: Right edge carries fragments of the neighbouring page and is omitted. Left margin marks are show-through and omitted. Greek "τοῖς ἰδίοις" is transcribed from a superscript-style setting; its accents are uncertain at the scan resolution. "neque unt" is doubtful (possibly "neque sunt") and is marked [?]. "propriissimis" is read from a slightly blurred "priifsimis" and the printed hyphen after "pro-" is taken from the line end. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout, including where the scan shows f-like forms (solem, suum, esse). The final line "inpri-" is a line-end hyphenation; "mis" below is the catchword.
